tei:div.tei:p: (shrī)༄༅// jo lugs dzaṃ dkar lha lnga'i phywa g.yang 'gugs pa'i cho ga 'dod rgu'i char 'bebs zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// rab 'byams rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad kyi// thugs rje zla shel bdud rtsi'i phung po la// puṇ+ḍa rī kas mtshan pa'i 'phags mchog dang*// mi phyed bla mar snying nas 'dud do skyongs// gang de'i snying rje'i spyan ras las// 'khrungs pa'i rmugs 'dzin dkar po yi// srid zhi'i phywa g.yang 'dod rgu'i char// 'bebs pa'i cho ga 'di na bskrun// de'ang sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas kyi ye shes sgyu ma'i rol gar jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha la 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs gyi zhal mngon sum du bstan nas sems can dbul ba'i sdug bsngal sel ba'i slad du 'phags pa'i spyan g.yas nas dzam+bha la dkar po lha lnga byon pa'i sgrub thabs phyi chu sbyin la brten pa/ nang gtor ma la brten pa/ gsang ba gwa'u la brten pa/ las tshogs thor bu ba/ dril nas bsgrub pa sogs gsungs pa las/ 'dir dril sgrub kyi yan lag snod bcud kyi phywa g.yang spel ba'i tshul la gsum/ sbyor dngos rje gsum mo// dang po ni/ tshes grangs spen snrar sogs kyi 'grub sbyor nyin mdzod phug gam bkra shis pa'i khang par stegs bu khebs ldan gyi khar pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi dbus dang phyogs bzhir lha'i sku mdog dang mthun pa'i tshon phung dgod pa'am 'bras dkar gyi tshom bu lnga bkod pa'i dbus su/ 'byor na zhu chen rin po che'i yig cha ltar nor sgrub kyi gwa'u lnga'am/ bsdu na gcig gang rung bca' sgrub tshad ldan bgyis pa yod na shin tu legs la/ ma 'dzom na dkar mngar g.yang rdzas bsres pa'i g.yang gtor gru bzhi ri rab bang rim steng pad+ma nor bu mig gsum 'bar ba'i rnam pa can la phyogs bzhir bshos phran dzaṃ gtor dbyibs can bzhi'i mtha' skor du ril bu zas snas phyur bur gtams pa bkod/ de'i mdun dang phyogs bzhir dngos grub blang ba'i rdzas lha'i phyag mtshan be con/

ne'u le/ kha ṭ+wāṃ/ rdo rje dang rten 'brel nor rdzas blugs pa'i snod/ rin po che dang bum pa bcud kyis gang ba kha rgyan dang bcas pa/ pad+ma dang lcags kyu/ sna tshogs rdo rje dang ne'u le'i rkyal pa rnams phyogs tha dad du dgod/ g.yas su snod gas chag med pa'i nang 'bras sam gro gtsang mas bkang bar/ dar dkar la gtso 'khor lnga'i sngags/ rten 'brel snying po sogs kyi mthar/ bdag dang rgyu sbyor sbyin pa'i bdag po'i tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor snyan grags mi nor longs spyod la sogs pa legs pa'i yon tan thams cad gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas la brtan par mdzad du gsol/ sarba puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/ de'i mthar rgyal srid sna bdun bkra shis rdzas rtags kyi gzugs bris pa dang*/ dar sna btags pa'i mda' dar ma nyams pa btsugs/ mthar bkra shis rdzas brgyad kyi tsaklis bskor/ g.yon du chu sbyin 'bul ba'i chas zangs gzhong bum pa dri bzangs 'o ma'i chus bkang la bzhag mdun du dkar gsum mngar gsum gyis sbags pa'i mchod gtor zlum 'khyil pad 'dab bzhi pa ril bu zas snas bskor ba/ gzhan yang 'dod yon lnga/ mchod pa rnam bdun/ bar mtshams mtha' skor rnams su phyugs po dgu'i zhing sa dang 'bru/ btsan po dgu'i khang sa dang mda'/ gos dar dang nor g.yang can gyi spu/ gser dngul sogs rin po che'i rigs/ dug rigs spangs pa'i sman sna/ 'bru dang shing thog kha zas sna tshogs/ ja dang dkar phud/ phye mar/ rin chen brdar ba'i gser skyems/ dngul zhal mar khus bkang ba rnams bkod legs su bzhag yod na gong gi rdzas rnams blugs pa'i g.yang khug khyad par mtshan ldan dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi lag nas byung ba'i ring bsrel rnam lnga sogs byin rten rigs dang*/ sku rten nor gzugs phyag mtshan sogs rten gsum gang rnyed/ gzhan yang mtho la brjid pa'i gangs ri/ sman mo gnod sbyin gnas pa'i sa rdo/ yul dge zhing shis la che brjid gnyan pa mi bzang ba'i sa/

gtsug lag khang dgon rdzong pho brang snyan grags can gyi dar dang rdzas gang 'dzom/ rgya dkar nag sogs gnas chen khyad par can rnams kyi sa rdo chu sna/ khang sa zhing sa sogs mdor na dme rmugs nal btsog grib dug can ma yin pa'i longs spyod nor rdzas rten gang 'tshogs te/ snga phyi de dag kun kyang bla ma rgyal po slob dpon sogs che btsun btsan drag 'phel phyug dar rgyas snyan grags 'dzoms sa nas blangs nas so so'i bla skar la blugs pa spro na bya ba'o// gzhan yang bla bre 'phan gdugs rgyal mtshan dang rigs kyi 'phyang 'phrul sogs spyan gzigs g.yang chags shing brjid pa'i mchod rdzas/ mthun pa'i spos sbyor/ rkang gling spangs pa'i rol mo la sogs pa mdor na 'og tu mkho ba'i yo byad ma tshang ba med pa 'du bya'o// gnyis pa la/ mchod pa byin rlabs ni/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri mchog zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur par bsams la so so'i phyag rgya bcas/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ de bzhin du pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+paṃ/ dhū paṃ/ dī paṃ/ gan+dhaṃ/ nai bi d+yaṃ/ oṃ badz+ra shab+da swā hā/ zhes dang rol mo sna tshogs dkrol zhing*/ oṃ badz+ra dharmā ra ṇi ta/ pra ra ṇi ta/ saṃ pra ra ṇi ta/ sarba bud+dha k+ṣe tra pra tsa li ni pradz+nyā pā ra mi tā nā da saṃ bha we na/ badz+ra dharmā hṛ da ya san+to ṣa ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ ho ho ho ā khaṃ swā hā/ zhes lan gsum brjod pas byin gyis brlab/ de nas bdag gi ting

'di la gzhan dag gis thugs rje chen po sogs kyi gong gnon mdzad kyang*/ jo bo'i rgya gzhung dang sngon gyi sgrub thabs rnams las ma byung zhing*/ spyan ras gzigs kyi spyan las 'khrungs pa sogs kyis shes so// mchan/ nge 'dzin ni/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed spyi ltar byas la/ rang skad cig gis dzaṃ bha lar gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas dzam+bha la la bla ma 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan pa mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs tshogs zhing spyan drang*/ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ na maḥpad+ma kro dha ār+ya dzam+bha la sa pa ri wā ra maṇ+ḍa le bh+yaḥs phyag bya/ gong gi sngags sham du ar+ghaṃ sogs btags pas mchod/ gur nas 'byung ba'i rgyun bshags bya/ tshad med bzhi bsgom/ dngos gzhi ni/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang*/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rang gi sems nyid dzam̐ dkar po de las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi dbul phongs kyi sdug bsngal bsal nas tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid 'phags pa dzam+bha la sku mdog gangs ri'i mdog ltar dkar ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ zhi zhing 'dzum la chags pa'i nyams can yid tsam khros pa/ spyan gsum pa/ dbu skra dkar ser gyen du brdzes shing*/ sma ra smin ma dkar ser gyen du 'khyil ba/ phyag g.yas kha ṭ+wāṃ rtse gsum dang*/ g.yon rin po che'i be con bsnams pa/ rin po che'i dbu rgyan/ snyan rgyan/ mgul rgyan se mo do/ 'og pags/ phyag gdub/ zhabs gdub rnams kyi spras shing*/ dar gyi yug gon stod g.yogs kyi tshul du 'phyangs shing pañtsa li ka'i sham thabs can/ g.yu 'brug gi steng na zhabs gnyis phyed skyil gyi tshul du bzhugs pa/ de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i dbus su zla gdan la dzam̐ dkar po 'od zer 'phro ba/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas dzam+bha la dkar po la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drang*/

gong ltar mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang 'od 'phros dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor bcas oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drang*/ oṃ pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ badz+rī bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan par bsam/ chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pas mchod/ shel dkar zhun ma'i phung por dbang gzhu yis// rab dkris gar dgu'i nyams ldan gnod sbyin dbang*// 'dod rgu'i dngos grub char ltar 'bebs mdzad pa// dpal ldan dzaṃ bha la la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes bstod/ bzlas pa bya ba ni/ rang gi snying gar zla ba'i gdan la dzam̐ yig dkar po'i mthar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ khyad par khams gsum gyi dpal 'byor longs spyod thams cad bsdus te ji ltar 'dod pa'i dngos grub thob par bsams la/ oṃ pad+ma kro dha ār+ya dzaṃ bha la hṛ da ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ji ltar rigs pa bzlas la/ bdag bskyed kyi ye shes pa mdun gyi nam mkhar byon par gyur/ oṃ pad+ma kro dha ār+ya dzam+bha la sa pa ri wā ra re re'i mgor sbyar ba'i ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da'i bar gyis mchod/ rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes sgyu ma las// 'dod dgu'i dpal ster rab brjid gnod sbyin dbang*// dbul phongs sdug bsngal kun sel nor gyi lha// mgon po dzam+bha la la phyag 'tshal bstod// bcom ldan 'das mgon po dzam+bha las bdag dang sems can thams cad kyis ma dag pa'i 'tsho ba spangs nas chos dang mthun pa'i 'byor pa phun sum tshogs pa la longs spyod pa'i skal ba dang ldan par mdzad du gsol/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs sh+lo gcig gi mthar/

badz+ra muḥs ye shes pa gshegs par bsam mo// de nas sngon 'gro g.yang glud gtong ba ni/ glud gzugs mar me changs bu mi kha'i rdzas lte phye/ nyung ma/ sbang ma/ thal ba/ shing bu sogs/ gang 'dzom bran la/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i snod yangs par lan chags glud kyi gtor ma rnams 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga'i rang bzhin glud bdag so so'i yid la dga' mgu phun sum tshogs pa bskyed cing tshim nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a ba lo ki te oṃ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra hūm̐/ lan bdun gyis bsngos/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen mang la phyag 'tshal lo// de bzhin gshegs pa gzugs mdzes dam pa la= de bzhin gshegs pa sku 'byams klas la= de bzhin gshegs pa 'jigs pa thams cad dang bral ba la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes brjod/ rang nyid skad cig gis dbang chen rta mchog rol pa drag gtum khro rngams mi bzad gzi byin chen po'i rang bzhin du gyur par bsams la/ hrīḥ nga ni rta mgrin dbang gi rgyal// nyon cig bse rag 'gong po'i tshogs// yod gang brgyags phyug mi dga' zhing*// med stongs ltog dbul gtong la dga'// rta phyugs god yams sna 'dren cing*// dkar thog lo thog sris la za// blo nyes tshong nyes gtong ba'i bdag /khyod la glud dang gtor ma sbyin// rang rang mthun rdzas 'di khyer la// rnal 'byor sbyin bdag 'khor bcas la// ma nye ma gnod ma 'khor bar// dpag tshad mang po'i pha rol dengs// gal te mi 'gro 'tshe byed na// sprul pa'i khro bo 'bar ba yis// lus sems brlag par gdon mi za// de bas myur du phyir dengs shig /oṃ hrīḥpad+mān+ta kṛ ta badz+ra kro dha ha ya grī wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ sogs kyi drag sngags kyi bskrad/ gu gul gyis bdug yungs kar gyis brab/ ting nge 'dzin gyis gzir cing glud gzugs phyir bskyal/

hrīḥ snang srid rdo rje me ri'i gur// de nang phyi snod rta mgrin sku// thugs kar rang nyid spyan ras gzigs// mtha' skor bsrung bya gsal bar gyur// oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ zhes lan gsum brjod cing bsrung ngo*// mdun gyi rten rnams a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i khang bzang gi dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar dzam̐ las rtse gsum dzam̐ gyis mtshan pa las dzam+bha la dkar po sku mdog gangs ri'i mdog ltar dkar ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ zhi zhing 'dzum la chags pa'i nyams can yid tsam khros pa/ spyan gsum pa/ dbu skra dkar ser gyen du brdzes shing*/ sma ra smin ma dkar ser gyen du 'khyil ba/ phyag g.yas kha ṭ+wāṃ rtse gsum dang*/ g.yon rin po che'i be con bsnams pa/ rin po che'i dbu rgyan snyan rgyan/ mgul rgyan/ se mo do/ 'og pag phyag gdub zhabs gdub rnams kyis spras shing*/ dar gyi yug gon stod g.yogs kyi tshul du 'phyang ba/ pañtsa li ka'i sham thabs can/ g.yu 'brug gi steng na zhabs phyed skyil gyi tshul du bzhugs pa/ shar gyi 'dab ma la hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las rdo rje ḍā ki nī nam mkha'i mdog can zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas gser gyi rdo rje dang*/ g.yon pas rten 'brel gyi nor rdzas bsnams pa/ lhor trām̐ las rin po che trām̐ gyis mtshan pa las rin chen ḍā ki nī ser mo g.yas nor bu/ g.yon rin po che'i bum pa bsnams pa/ nub tu pam̐ las pad+ma pam̐ gyis mtshan pa las pad+ma ḍā ki nī dmar mo g.yas pad+ma/ g.yon lcags kyu bsnams pa/ byang du kham̐ las ral gri kham̐ gis mtshan pa las kyi ḍā ki nī ljang gu g.yas rdo rje rgya gram/ g.yon ne'u le nor bu skyugs pa bsnams pa/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ dbu skra ser po thor tshugs can/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yon bskum g.yon brkyang ba'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/

de rnams kyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ thugs ka'i dbus su zla gdan la dzam̐ dkar po 'od zer 'phro ba/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas 'phags pa dzam̐ bha la dkar po rigs bzhi mkha' 'gro dang bcas pa la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ spos sbyor bdug la snyan pa'i dbyangs dang rol mor bcas pa/ hūm̐/ sngon gyi bskal pa'i dang po la// rgyal ba kun gyi thugs rje las// 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs su sprul// brtse ba chen pos gshegs su gsol// 'gro ba'i dbul ba sel ba'i phyir// spyan chab g.yas las sprul pa'i sku// dzaṃ lha 'brug zhon lha lnga po// thugs rje'i dbang gis gshegs su gsol// 'phags pa thugs rje chen po yis// gnod sbyin rgyal po'i bu sprul tshe// dzam+bha la zhes mtshan gsol ba// nor lha'i rgyal po thugs rje can// rmugs 'dzin dkar po mkha' 'gro'i tshogs// nor lha gter bdag rgya mtshos bskor// thugs dam dbang gis gnas 'dir byon// dngos grub stsol phyir gshegs su gsol// oṃ pad+ma kro dha ār+ya dzam+bha la sa pa ri wā ra e h+ye hi/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang 'od 'phros dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor bcas oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drang*/ oṃ pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da'i bar gyis mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ badz+rī bha ba a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yur lud pa las gtso bor 'od dpag med/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro la mi bskyod pa/ rin chen mkha' 'gro la rin chen 'byung ldan/ pad+ma mkha' 'gro la 'od dpag med/ las kyi mkha' 'gro la don yod grub pas dbur brgyan/

mchod rdzas longs spyod rnams/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ ma dag chos kun skye med klong du yal// dag pa rin chen snod mchog rab yangs par// lha mi'i phun tshogs las grub gtor ma dang*// sna bdun mchod pa 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga// bkra shis rdzas rtags rgyal srid rin chen bdun// dar zab spyan gzigs dkor nor la sogs pa// kun bzang mchod pa'i dpal la 'gran bzod pa// srid mtha'i bar du 'byung zhing rgyas gyur cig /oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis gtor ma dang*/ ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe sogs kyis mchod/ oṃ sarba bit+pū ra pū ra sogs brjod pas rten rdzas rnams byin gyis brlab/ hrīḥ stong gsum 'di dang gzhan dag na// mchod yon zhabs bsil me tog spos// snang gsal dri mchog zhal zas dang*// sgra snyan rol mo'i bye brag tshogs// re re'ang bgrang yas mtha' klas pa// mchod pa'i lha mo grangs med pas// rgyal ba rnams la mchod pa ltar// dzaṃ lha 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// bzhes nas mi phyugs longs spyod sogs// phywa g.yang 'gugs pa'i phrin las mdzod// oṃ pad+ma kro dha ār+ya dzaṃ bha la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da'i bar re re bzhin sbyar bas mchod/ yid 'ong gzugs dang snyan pa'i sgra// yid 'dzin dri dang ro brgya'i zas// 'jam mnyen 'khril chags reg bya'i mchog /'dod yon nam mkha'i khams gang ba// dzaṃ lha 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// bzhes nas= /phywa g.yang= /oṃ pad+ma kro dha ār+ya dzaṃ bha la sa pa ri wā ra pañtsa kā ma gu ṇa pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ rin chen gdugs mdzes gser nya dang*// gter chen bum pa pad+ma bzang*// dung dkar g.yas 'khyil dpal be'u// mchog gi rgyal mtshan 'khor lo sogs// dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol ba'i phyir// dzaṃ lha 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// bzhes nas= /phywa g.yang= /sngags thog mtha' 'dra bar/ aṣ+ṭa maṅga la tsih+ṇa/ phun tshogs 'khor lo rin po che// dri med btsun mo khyim bdag dang*// cang shes rta dang glang po dang*// phas kyi rgol ba tshar gcod pa'i// dmag dpon rin chen sna bdun rnams// bdag gi bsam pa yongs rdzogs phyir// dzaṃ lha 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// bzhes nas=

/phywa g.yang= /sap+ta rat+na/ yid 'ong nags tshal ral gri dang*// khang bzang mal cha lha yi gos// sbrul gyi pags pa l+h+wam la sogs// dzaṃ lha 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// bzhes nas= /phywa g.yang= /sap+ta u pa rat+na/ me long gi waṃ ba zho dang*/ dūrba bilba li khri dung*// nyungs kar la sogs bkra shis rdzas// dzaṃ lha 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// bzhes nas= /phywa g.yang= /aṣ+ṭa maṅga la dra bya/ mdor na lha klu mi'i bsags pa// yo byad ji snyed mchis so cog /ma tshang med pa grangs kyi gtos// chos dbyings khyab gdal chen po'i dpyid// tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs pa'i phyir// dzaṃ lha 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// bzhes nas mi phyugs longs spyod sogs// phywa g.yang 'gugs pa'i phrin las mdzod// oṃ pad+ma kro dha ār+ya dzaṃ bha la sa pa ri wā ra sarba pū dza hoḥ jo bos mdzad pa'i bstod pa ni/ spyan ras gzigs dbang 'jig rten mgon po'i spyan chab las 'khrungs nor bdag rin chen brjid pa'i sku// gangs ri ltar dkar rab mdzes 'gro tshogs dbul phongs mtha' dag sdug bsngal ma lus zhi mdzad cing*// zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum 'gro la bu gcig ltar brtse phyogs bcu kun tu gzigs mdzad pa// bsam 'phel nor bu dpag bsam shing 'dra de la bdag yid gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi// dug gsum la sogs ngan 'gro'i sa bon myu gu gcod mdzad phyag g.yas kha ṭ+wāṃ rtse gsum 'dzin// g.yon pas be con nor bdag ma lus dbang du sdud cing bkres skom nad dang sdug bsngal 'joms// dbu skra dkar ser gyen du brdzes shing lan bu'i cod pan lhab lhub rgyan gyis kun nas mdzes// nor bdag chen po 'brug la chibs pas bdag dang sems can kun gyi dbul phongs zhi bar mdzod// dang*/ gangs ri ltar dkar zhal gcig phyag gnyis 'brug gi steng na brjid pa'i sku// spyan ras gzigs dbang thugs rje'i rnam 'phrul 'gro la 'dod rgu'i char 'bebs pa// yi dam khyod la gus pas 'dud do byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar// log 'tsho bral ba'i 'byor pa chen po kun nas rgyas pa'i dngos grub stsol// ces dang*/

kye/ 'di ni thugs rje chen po nor lha 'phags pa ni// gti mug rnam dag chos dbyings ye shes ngo bo nyid// mdog dkar rin chen rgyan bcas zhal gcig phyag gnyis na// rtse gsum be con 'dzin mdzad zhal gdangs 'brug la zhon// dbu skra dkar ser gyen brdzes spyan gsum srid gsum gzigs// 'phags pa khyod la phyag 'tshal mchod do dngos grub slong*// shar du zhe sdang rnam dag me long ye shes sku// rdo rje mkha' 'gro mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma// g.yas pas rdo rje g.yon pas rten 'brel rdzas rnams bsnams// lho ru ser sna rnam dag mnyam nyid ye shes sku// rin chen mkha' 'gro ser mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma// g.yas pas rin chen g.yon pas bcud kyi bum pa bsnams// nub tu 'dod chags rnam dag kun rtog ye shes sku// pad+ma mkha' 'gro dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma// g.yas pas pad+ma g.yon pas rin chen lcags kyu bsnams// byang du phrag dog rnam dag bya grub ye shes sku// las kyi mkha' 'gro ljang gu zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma// g.yas pas rgya gram g.yon pas nor gyi rkyal pa bsnams// kun kyang rin chen rgyan ldan phyed skyil gar gyis bzhengs// mkha' 'gro bzhi la phyag 'tshal mchod bstod dngos grub slong*// nor rnams ster ba med na nor lha'i ming ma mchis// nor rnams ster phyir nor gyi lha ru grags pas na// thugs rje'i phyag rkyong rin chen gter phye nor ster bas// phongs pa'i tshogs rnams dpal dang 'byor pas phyug par mdzod// ces pa rnams kyis bstod/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka'i sa bon sngags phreng la phog de gnyis kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer lcags kyu dang zhags pa'i rnam pa dpag tu med pa 'phros/ 'jig rten gyi lha klu gnod sbyin stobs ldan rnams dang*/ mi'i dbang po la sogs pa'i stobs ldan thams cad bkug ste mdun bskyed kyi lha'i phyag mtshan rnams la thim pas/

de rnams las rin po che gos dar nor dbyig 'bru rigs rkang 'gros la sogs pa dgos 'dod thams cad char bzhin du babs nas dpal 'byor longs spyod zad mi shes pa dang*/ mi nor zas gsum 'du zhing thos bsam sgom gsum 'phel ba sogs 'khor 'das kyi legs tshogs thams cad gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par bsams la/ thog mar gtso sngags ci nus bzlas la mthar/ 'khor sngags/ oṃ badz+ra ḍā ki nī pi sha ni swā hā/ oṃ rat+na ḍā ki nī pi shā ni swā hā/ oṃ pad+ma ḍā ki nī pi shā ni swā hā/ oṃ karma ḍā ki nī pi shā ni swā hā/ zhes so so'am/ oṃ pad+ma kro dha ār+ya dzaṃ bha la hṛ da ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ badz+ra ḍā ki nī rat+na ḍā ki nī pad+ma ḍā ki nī karma ḍā ki nī pi shā ni sarba sid+dhi swā hā/ zhes dril sngags brgya stong sogs ci 'grub bzlas mthar yig brgya dbyangs gsal rten 'brel snying po rnams bdun re bzla'o// chu sbyin ni/ snod mdun du bzhag la/ rang nyid 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas mchog sbyin dang g.yon pad+ma dkar po bsnams pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ ri dwags kyi pags pas nu ma g.yon pa bkab pa/ zhabs gnyis sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs par gsal ba'i phyag g.yas pa'i mchog sbyin las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs par bsams la/ bum pa nas chu sbreng ba mdun bskyed la phul ba'i mos pas/ oṃ pad+ma kro dha ār+ya dzam+bha la hṛ da ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brgya rtsa brgyad dang lha mo bzhi'i sngags kyang ci rigs bzlas la/ chu mu tig gi phreng bar gyur cing*/ nor bdag gtso 'khor lnga'i zhal nas kyang mu tig gi char phab nas bdag dang sbyin bdag la dngos grub stsol bar bsams la phul/ oṃ pad+ma kro dha ār+ya dzam+bha la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ 'gro ba dbul ba'i sdug bsngal gzigs gyur nas// 'jig rten mgon po'i spyan chab las 'khrungs shing*// gangs ri ltar dkar nor 'chang kun gyi rje// mkha' 'gro bzhi yis bskor la phyag 'tshal bstod// ser sna'i las kyi me yis gdung ba dag

/skye dang skye bar khyed la gsol 'debs kyi// rin chen bdud rtsi'i gter gyi char rgyun gyis// sems can dbul ba'i sdug bsngal zhi bar mdzod// oṃ pad+ma kro dha ār+ya dzam+bha la rat+na sarba sid+dhi pha la hoḥ zhes chu thigs mtheb srin gyis lce la bzhag cing sbyin bdag la'ang blud de dngos grub blang*/ yig brgya bzla zhing phyogs bzhir gtor/ thams cad nam mkha'i mdzod sogs brjod/ gtor ma chab kyis bran te a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa 'dod rgu 'byung ba'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis brlab/ mdun bskyed gtso 'khor lnga'i zhal nas 'od kyi sbu gu byung ste gsol bar bsam/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya dang bcas/ oṃ pad+ma kro dha ār+ya dzam+bha la hṛ da ya hūm̐ phaṭa i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan bdun/ oṃ badz+ra ḍā ki nī rat+na ḍā ki nī pad+ma ḍā ki ni karma ḍā ki nī i daṃ sogs btags pa lan gsum gyis phul/ oṃ pad+ma kro dha ār+ya dzaṃ bha la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ thugs rje chen po'i spyan chab las 'khrungs shing*// rtse gsum dbyug pas dug gsum dbul ba sel// gnas skabs mthar thug dgos 'dod kun 'byung ba// yid bzhin nor bu khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// las bzhi'i phrin las sgrub la thogs med cing*// rnam 'phrul ma nges sprul pa phyogs bcur 'gyed// gdul bya'i re ba skong mdzad mkha' 'gro ma// sgyu ma'i gzugs can bzhi la phyag 'tshal bstod// nor bdag chen po 'khor dang bcas pas bdag dang sems can thams cad la chos dang mthun pa'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa stsal du gsol/ zhes mchod bstod 'dod don gsol gdab bya'o// de nas phywa g.yang dngos sgrub pa la dang po byung khungs ston pa ni/

kye/ dang po g.yang len gar srid na// sngon gyi bskal pa dang po la// kha ba can gyi rgyal khams su// spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul pa las// spre'u byang chub sems dpa' byung*// jo mo sgrol ma'i sprul pa las// brag srin nag mo bya ba byung*// de gnyis thabs shes 'phrad pa las// gdong dmar mi gsum thams cad byung*// mi rnams phongs pas mnar ba las// spre'u'i rgyal po yar gshegs te// po ta la yi rtse mo na// spyan ras gzigs dbang bzhugs pa la// spre'u'i rgyal pos 'di skad zhus// kye ma las kyi 'bras bu yi// dbon sras mang po 'phel ba las// dran pa gsal ba lha dang 'dra// gdug rtsub che ba lha min 'dra// gos med gcer bu dud 'gro 'dra// bkres skom sdug bsngal yi dwags 'dra// shin tu sdug bsngal dmyal ba 'dra// rigs drug sdug bsngal nges par tshang*// 'di dag las thabs ci zhig bya// de skad zhus pas bka' stsal pa// spre'u'i rgyal po legs par nyon// khyod kyi bu dang tsha bo rnams// gdong dmar srin po yin zer te// kha ba can gyi zhing khams su// byin gyis brlabs pa'i sprul pa yin// zas la 'bru rigs sna tshogs zo// skom du 'byung ba chu la 'thung*// gos su lha yi na bza' gtod// skabs su g.yang 'gugs g.yang blan bya// spyan ras gzigs kyis de skad gsungs// de nas spre'u'i rgyal po des// sngags 'chang rgyal po spyan yang drangs// lha gzhi dkar po'i gdan steng du// dkon mchog mchod pa rgya chen bshams// rgod sgro mda' dar dkar po la// dngul dkar me long btags pas g.yab// khu ye brjod cing 'o dod bos// thugs rje chen po'i byin rlabs dang*// sngags 'chang bdag gi sme sngags dang*// dbu nag bod kyi bsod nams las// 'od zer sna lnga steng du 'phros// tshangs pa dung thod dkar por phog /lha yi longs spyod ldan pa las// 'od rlung dkar po gcig tu sprul// lha yi longs spyod bod du 'ongs// bod lha khams 'dra ba de nas srid// 'od zer 'og tu 'phros pa las// klu rgyal gtsug na rin chen phog

/klu yi longs spyod 'phel ba las// klu yi longs spyod bod du 'ongs// bod klu las grol ba de nas srid// 'od zer bar snang khams su 'phros// gnyan gyi rgyal po chen por phog /gnyan gyi longs spyod bod du 'ongs// bod 'grol thabs gnyan pa de nas srid// 'od zer shar phyogs gling du 'phros// yul 'khor srung gi rgyal po la// longs spyod ldan zhing skye ba bzang*// shar phyogs g.yang rnams bod du 'ongs// bod skye ba bzang don de nas srid// 'od zer lho phyogs gling du 'phros// 'phags skyes po yi rgyal po la// longs spyod ldan zhing dkor nor phyug /longs spyod g.yang rnams bod du 'ongs// bod dkor nor phyug don de nas srid// 'od zer nub phyogs gling du 'phros// spyan mi bzang gi rgyal po la// longs spyod ldan zhing mi 'phel che// nub phyogs g.yang rnams bod du 'ongs// bod mi 'phel che ba de nas srid// 'od zer byang gi phyogs su 'phros// rnam thos sras kyi rgyal po la// longs spyod ldan zhing sku tshe ring*// byang phyogs g.yang rnams bod du 'ongs// bod sku tshe ring ba de nas srid// 'od zer phyogs bcu kun tu 'phros// phyogs bcu'i nor lha kun la phog /de rnams longs spyod bod du 'ongs// bod nor g.yang 'phel ba de nas srid// 'od zer rgya gar yul du 'phros// rgya gar chos g.yang bod du 'ongs// bod chos la dkar ba de nas srid// 'od zer stag gzig yul du 'phros// stag gzig nor rnams bod du 'ongs// bod dkor nor phyug pa de nas srid// 'od zer rgya nag yul du 'phros// rgya yi ja dar bod du 'ongs// bod ja dar 'phel ba de nas srid// 'od zer hor gyi yul du 'phros// hor gyi rta g.yang bod du 'ongs// bod rta drel mang ba de nas srid// 'od zer bod kyi yul du 'phros// mi dang g.yang gnyis kyi li li// phywa dang g.yang gnyis sga ra ra// longs spyod sna tshogs de las tshogs// sngon gyi bzang 'phro'i dpal bzhin du// dar dkar g.yob cing 'dir 'bod na// de ring khu ye phywa g.yang len// dngos gzhi g.yang bsgrub pa la/

gtso bo'i dmigs bzlas/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro/ rin chen mkha' 'gro/ pad+ma mkha' 'gro/ las kyi mkha' 'gro ste rigs bzhi'i mkha' 'gro'i dmigs bzlas dang lnga las/ dang po ni/ bdag lha'i thugs 'od sngags phreng dang bcas pa// rang gi zhal nas 'thon te mchod pa'i tshul// mdun bskyed gtso bo'i zhal du zhugs pa las// dzaṃ yig dkar po sngags phreng bcas la thim// slar yang sngags phreng las thon mdun bskyed kyi// lte ba nas byung rang gi lte ba ru// dngos grub tshul du zhugs te de lta bu// rgyun mi 'chad par 'khor bas thugs rgyud bskul// thugs rje'i 'od kyis rgyal ba sras bcas mchod// rgyal ba'i gsang gsum byin rlabs dngos grub dang*// 'khor ba'i tshe bsod dpal 'byor lha klu mi'i// mnga' thang nor lha 'jig rten skyong rnams kyi// phywa g.yang dngos grub 'od zer tshul du bsdus// rang dang mdun bskyed gtso bo'i ga'u dang*/

gwa'u med na gtso bo'i rten rdzas dang*/ mchan/ /g.yang rten la thim tshe bsod dpal 'byor sogs// phun sum tshogs pa'i dngos grub myur thob gyur// oṃ pad+ma kro dha ār+ya dzam+bha la hṛ da ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ pi shā ni 'jig rten khams kyi lha 'dre mi gsum 'gro ba thams cad bdag gi dbang du gyur cig swā hā/ zhes gtso bor ci 'grub bungs bskyed la bzla/ gnyis pa rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i dmigs bzlas ni/ bdag lha'i thugs 'od sngon po dmar mdangs can// gtso mo la thim de yi thugs rje'i 'od// rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i thugs kar zla ba'i steng*// ha sngon sngags kyis bskor ba la thim pas// sngags de g.yon du drag tu 'khor ba las// 'od zer mthing dmar lcags kyu lta bu 'phros// lha klu mi rnams rang dbang med par 'dus// mos pa rnam bzhi zhes bya pha ma dang*// bla ma rgyal po spun grogs 'du shes kyis// byams dang gus ldan skrag dang brtse gyur nas// tshe bsod longs spyod dngos grub tshogs bsdus te// rang dang rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i gwa'ur rten la/ thim// khams gsum snod bcud dpal la spyod par gyur// gtso sngags dang*/ oṃ badz+ra ḍā ki nī wa shaṃ ni steng lha'i srid pa/ 'og klu'i srid pa/ bar mi'i srid pa thams cad bdag gi dbang du gyur cig swā hā/ zhes bzla/ gsum pa rin chen mkha' 'gro'i dmigs bzlas ni/ bdag lha'i thugs 'od btso ma'i gser lta bu// gtso bo la thim de yi thugs ka'i 'od// rin chen mkha' 'gro'i thugs kar zla ba'i steng*// ri yig ser po sngags kyis bskor ba la// thim zhing sngags de g.yon du drug tu 'khor// de las 'od zer dmar ser li khri'i mdangs// phyogs bcur 'phros pas 'jig rten khams kun gyi// bza' btung zhim mngar nor rdzas phun tshogs pa'i// dngos grub thams cad 'od zer rnam par bsdus// bdag dang rin chen mkha' 'gro gwa'u

g.yang rten/ la// thim pas rma g.yang zas kyi dngos grub rnams// 'bad rtsol med par myur du thob par gyur// gtso sngags dang*/ oṃ rat+na ḍā ki nī ba shaṃ ni lha dang mi dang lha ma yin gyi nor rdzas khyad par can thams cad bdag gi dbang du gyur cig swā hā/ zhes bzla/ bzhi pa/ pad+ma mkha' 'gro'i dmigs bzlas ni/ bdag lha'i thugs 'od pad+ma rā ga'i mdangs// gtso bo la thim de yi thugs rje'i 'od// pad+ma ḍā ki'i thugs kar zla ba'i steng*// ni yig dmar po sngags phreng bskor ba la// thim pas sngags de g.yon du drag tu 'khor// de las 'od dmar lcags kyu lta bu 'phros// rgyal po blon po btsan phyug 'phen dar can// yul mi dbang chen nor bu'i bdag po klu// sa bdag yul lha thams cad mos pa bzhis// dbang du 'dus nas bsod nams dpal 'byor rnams// tshur bsdus rang dang pad+ma mkha' 'gro yi// gwa'u g.yang rten la thim srid gsum dbang du gyur// gtso sngags dang*/ pad+ma ḍā ki nī ba shaṃ ni rgyal po dang blon po dang btsan phyug dar rgyas can gyi yul mi dang nor bu rin po che bdag byed pa'i klu chen po sa bdag thams cad bdag gi dbang du gyur cig swā hā/ zhes bzla/ lnga pa las kyi mkha' 'gro'i dmigs bzlas ni/ bdag lha'i thugs 'od ljang gu dmar mdangs can// gtso bo la thim de yi thugs rje'i 'od// las kyi mkha' 'gro'i thugs kar zla ba'i steng*// sa yig ljang gu sngags kyis bskor ba las// thim pas sngags de g.yon du drag tu 'khor// de las 'od zer ljang dmar lcags kyu'i dbyibs// phyogs bcur 'phros pas lha 'dre mi gsum rnams// mos pa rnam bzhis rang dbang med par 'dus// zas dang nor dang rta phyugs g.yang can gyi// dngos grub sna tshogs 'od zer tshul du bsdus// bdag dang las kyi mkha' 'gro'i gwa 'u la// thim pas zas nor dgos 'dod lhun grub gyur// gtso sngags dang*/

oṃ oṃ karma ḍā ki nī ba shaṃ ni lha 'dre mi gsum gyi zas nor g.yang can sna tshogs bdag gi dbang du gyur cig swā hā/ zhes 'khor bzhi la gtso sngags kyi bcu cha tsam re bzlas mthar lhag chad kha skong yig brgya dbyangs gsal rten 'brel snying po rnams kyang bzla/ de nas g.yang 'gugs pa la thog mar lha'i thugs rgyud bskul ba ni/ slob dpon gyis mda' dar g.yob cing*/ kye/ rab 'byams rgyal ba'i sbyin pa'i stobs las grub// 'phags mchog thugs rje'i spyan las 'khrungs pa'i sras// gzugs phung gti mug rnam dag chos dbyings mdangs// ār+ya dzaṃ la dkar po 'brug la chibs// 'dod rgu'i char 'bebs be con ne'u le 'dzin// sbas yum kha ṭ+wāṃ tshul gyi dbyings phyug ma'i// thugs sprul bud+dha gar dbang mkha' 'gro ma// dkar mo sna tshogs mkha' 'gro 'bum gyis bskor// phyag na sdud byed g.yab dar dkar po bsnams// sna tshogs las kun myur 'grub bden mthu can// dar dkar g.yab cing rgyud bskul spyan 'dren no// tshe bsod dpal 'byor phywa g.yang 'gugs par mdzod// phyogs bcu'i nam mkha'i nus bcud tshe bsod g.yang*// steng 'og lha klu sa bdag lag nas drongs// mi phyugs gnas khang nor rdzas rten 'dir bstims// dwangs gsal gdal khyab tshe g.yang brtan par mdzod// hūm̐/ rnam shes zhe sdang rnam dag me long mdangs// dus gsum rgyal ba'i yum mchog mā ma kī'i// thugs sprul rdo rje gar dbang mkha' 'gro ma// sngon mo zhi ba'i mkha' 'gro 'bum gyis bskor// phyag na 'gugs byed g.yab dar sngon po bsnams// mi mthun las kun gzhom pa'i bden mthu can// dar sngon g.yab cing rgyud bskul spyan 'dren no// tshe bsod dpal 'byor phywa g.yang 'gugs par mdzod// phyogs bcu'i chu khams nus bcud tshe bsod g.yang*// shar phyogs dri za rgyal 'gong lag nas drongs// mi phyugs gnas khang nor rdzas rten 'dir stims// snum bcud dkyus ring tshe g.yang brtan par mdzod// hūm̐/

tshor ba nga rgyal rnam dag mnyam nyid mdangs// dus gsum rgyal yum sangs rgyas spyan ma yi// thugs sprul rin chen gar dbang mkha' 'gro ma// ser mo rgyas pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum gyis bskor// phyag na 'chings byed g.yab dar ser po bsnams// tshe bsod dpal 'byor skyed pa'i bden mthu can// dar ser g.yab cing rgyud bskul spyan 'dren no// tshe bsod dpal 'byor phywa g.yang 'gugs par mdzod// phyogs bcu'i sa khams nus bcud tshe bsod g.yang*// lho phyogs gshin rje the'u srin lag nas drongs// mi phyugs gnas khang nor rdzas rten 'dir bstim// sra brtan gzhom med tshe g.yang brtan par mdzod// hūm̐/ 'du shes 'dod chags rnam dag sor rtog mdangs// dus gsum rgyal ba skyed yum gos dkar mo'i// thugs sprul pad+ma gar dbang mkha' 'gro ma// dmar mo dbang gi mkha' 'gro 'bum gyis bskor// phyag na sdom byed g.yab dar dmar po bsnams// snang srid dbang du 'gugs pa'i bden mthu can// dar dmar g.yab cing rgyud bskul spyan 'dren no// tshe bsod dpal 'byor phywa g.yang 'gugs par mdzod// phyogs bcu'i me khams nus bcud tshe bsod g.yang*// nub phyogs klu dbang btsan bdud lag nas drongs// mi phyugs gnas khang nor rdzas rten 'dir stims// drod bkrag gzi 'bar tshe g.yang brtan par mdzod// hūm̐/ 'du byed phrag dog rnam dag bya grub mdangs// dus gsum rgyal yum dam tshig sgrol ma yi// thugs sprul karma gar dbang mkha' 'gro ma// ljang mo las kyi mkha' 'gro 'bum gyis bskor// phyag na mnyes byed g.yab dar ljang gu bsnams// bar chad dgra bgegs 'dul ba'i bden mthu can// dar ljang g.yab cing rgyud bskul spyan 'dren no// tshe bsod dpal 'byor phywa g.yang 'gugs par mdzod// phyogs bcu'i rlung khams nus bcud tshe bsod g.yang*// byang phyogs gnod sbyin ma mo'i lag nas drongs// mi phyugs gnas khang nor rdzas rten 'dir bstims// g.yo myur stobs ldan tshe g.yang brtan par mdzod// ces 'dun pa rtse gcig pas bskul nas g.yang 'gugs dngos ni/

kye/ steng phyogs lha khams rnams kyi g.yang*// de ring khu ye phywa g.yang khug /bar snang gnyan gyi rgyal po'i g.yang*// de ring khu ye phywa= /sa 'og klu yi rgyal po'i g.yang*// de ring= /shar phyogs yul 'khor srung gi g.yang*// de ring= /lho phyogs 'phags skyes po yi g.yang*// de ring= /nub phyogs spyan mi bzang gi g.yang*// de ring= /byang phyogs rnam thos sras kyi g.yang*// de ring= /phyogs skyong nor lha rnams kyi g.yang*// de ring= /lha 'dre mthu rtsal can gyi g.yang*// de ring= /rgya gar rgyal po'i chos g.yang de// de ring= /rgya nag rgyal po'i dar g.yang de// de ring= /stag gzig rgyal po'i nor g.yang de/ de ring= /ge sar rgyal po'i dmag g.yang de// de ring= /bal po'i skye bzhin legs g.yang de// de ring= /sog po'i mda' rtsal che ba'i g.yang*// de ring= /dgung sngon mthon po'i pha g.yang de// de ring= /dog mo sa yi ma g.yang de// de ring= /nyi zla skar gsum bkrag g.yang de// de ring= /'ja' tshon sna lnga'i bkrag g.yang de// de ring= /lho sprin smug po'i phyug g.yang de// de ring= /ri rab lhun po'i brtan g.yang de= /de ring= /gling chen bzhi yi bkod g.yang de// de ring= /gling phran brgyad kyi 'khor g.yang de// de ring= /ri phran rnams kyi btsun g.yang de// de ring= /rgya mtsho chen po'i zab g.yang de// de ring= /dpag bsam shing gi lo g.yang de// de ring= /rtsi shing nags tshal 'phen g.yang de// de ring= /phyug po rnams kyi phyug g.yang de// de ring= /'phen po rnams kyi 'phen g.yang de// de ring= /btsan po rnams kyi btsan g.yang de// de ring= /snyan pa rnams kyi snyan g.yang de// de ring= /'chi med rdo rje'i tshe g.yang de// de ring= /rgyal ba rnams kyi thugs rje'i g.yang*// de ring khu ye phywa g.yang khug /khu ye phywa khug g.yang khug la// g.yang len phud kyis nor lha mchod// g.yang len phud kyis phyugs lha mchod// g.yang len phud kyis khyim lha mchod// g.yang len phud kyis tshe lha mchod// ces pa dngos gzhi 'di rnams 'don sgom nan tan dang 'brel bar grangs gang 'gro yid ches pa bya'o// gzhan yang spro na/

g.yang len phud kyis nor lha mchod gsungs pa'i don bsang mchod 'bul bar 'dod pas/ shing sna dri bzang gi dud pa cher btang zhing phye mar sogs phud rigs thams cad mchod la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ dpal ldan phun tshogs rigs kyi bdag /rin chen 'byung ldan yab yum 'khor// ār+ya dzaṃ lha rigs lnga dang*// nor rgyun lha mo rnam thos sras// nor lha gter bdag 'khor bcas dang*// yul lha khyim lha dgra lha sogs// dpal g.yang bdag po thams cad la// dag byed shing sna'i dud pas bsang*// 'dod rgu dpal gyi mchod pa 'bul// dbul phongs rgud pa zhi bar mdzod// zas nor phyugs sogs longs spyod dngos// mi zad rgya mtsho'i dngos grub stsol// ces dang*/ nor lha'i bsang rgyas pa skabs su bab pa dag kyang lcogs na legs pa'i yan lag tu 'gyur ro// de nas g.yang dngos grub tu len pa la/ thog mar sgrub pa po rang nyid kyis len pa'i phyir gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ hrīḥ thugs rje chen po'i lha tshogs dang*// nor bdag dzaṃ lha 'khor bcas kyi// bden pa'i stobs dang byin rlabs kyis// 'jig rten khams kyi zas dang nor// gser dngul zangs lcags g.yu mu tig /srid zhi'i dpal yon 'dod rgu rnams// ma lus thams cad dbang bsdus la// sgrub pa po la dngos grub stsol// sarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐/ zhes gdung shugs kyis gsol ba btab pas/ so so nas dgyes shing brtse ba chen pos dngos grub gnang ba'i bka' 'di bzhin stsal bar gyur par bsams la/ dngos grub kyi rdzas so so'i phyag mtshan rnams las dang po gtso bo'i be con ne'u le kha ṭ+wāṃ ga blangs te/ rje btsun dzaṃ lha dkar po yi// sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs dang*// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub rnams// bu yis myur du thob par shog /oṃ pad+ma kro dha ār+ya dzam+bha la hṛ da ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ rgyal ba sras bcas kyi gsang gsum byin rlabs 'jig rten khams kyi tshe dang bsod nams dbang thang dpal 'byor thams cad bu'i dbang du gyur cig

ces gsung gnang bar bsams la spyi bor reg gnyis pa rdo rje dang rten 'brel rdzas snod thogs la/ bcom ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma'i// sku gsung thugs sogs tshig rkang gsum 'og ma rnams la'ang 'gre/ oṃ badz+ra ḍā ki nī bi shā ni steng lha'i srid pa/ 'og klu'i srid pa/ bar mi'i srid pa thams cad rigs kyi bu 'di'i dbang du gyur cig swā hā/ gsum pa rin po che dang bum pa thogs la/ bcom ldan rin chen mkha' 'gro ma'i// sku sogs/ oṃ rat+na ḍā ki nī pi shā ni/ 'jig rten khams kyi nor rdzas thams cad rigs kyi bu 'di'i dbang du gyur cig swā hā/ bzhi pa pad+ma dang lcags kyu thogs la/ bcom ldan pad+ma mkha' 'gro ma'i// sku sogs/ oṃ pad+ma ḍā ki ni pi shā ni/ rgyal po dang blon po dang yul mi dbang che ba rnams dang*/ nor bu'i bdag po klu chen po la sogs pa rnams rigs kyi bu 'di'i dbang du gyur cig swā hā/ lnga pa sna tshogs rdo rje dang ne'u le thogs la/ bcom ldan las kyi mkha' 'gro ma'i// sku sogs/ oṃ karma ḍā ki nī pi shā ni/ yul mi phyug po dang*/ zas nor sna tshogs pa rigs kyi bu 'di'i dbang du gyur cig swā hā/ zhes so so'i rang rtags phyag mtshan rnams gtad nas dngos grub ma lus pa stsal ba'i mos pa bskyed cing lha las dbang dang dngos grub blang*/ slar yang 'khor 'das snod bcud kyi g.yang len pa ni/ kye/ mtho ba srid gsum yang rtse nas// rlung gi rgya gram yan bar gyi// khams lnga'i nus bcud tshe dpal g.yang*// deng 'dir khu ye phywa g.yang len// phyogs bcu dag pa'i zhing khams dang*// 'dzam gling rnga yab gzhan gsum nas// dam pa chos kyi chab srid de// deng 'dir khu ye phywa g.yang len// lha gnas sum cu rtsa gsum dang*// lus 'phags lus dang 'phags pa nas// mtho ris snyan grags rgyal srid de// deng 'dir khu ye= /gnod sbyin grong khyer khang bzang dang*// ba lang spyod gling g.yo lam nas// ba phyugs nor mdzod rma g.yang de// deng 'dir=

/mtho ris nam mkha'i gnas rnams dang*// sgra mi snyan gnyis de'i zla nas// 'chi med tshe yi srog g.yang de// deng 'dir= /bsam gtan bzhi gnas man chad dang*// sa 'og lto 'phye'i gnas yan gyi// bde skyid mnga' ris phun tshogs de// deng 'dir khu ye phywa g.yang len// zhes dang*/ kye/ phyogs bcu dus gsum byon pa yi// dkon mchog rin chen rnam gsum dang*// rtsa brgyud bla ma'i byin rlabs de// deng 'dir khu ye phywa g.yang len// theg pa rim dgu rgyud sde bzhi'i// yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs kyi// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub de// deng 'dir= /gnas gsum dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dang*// chos srung dam can rgya mtsho'i sde'i// gang bcol g.yel med phrin las de// deng 'dir= /gnod sbyin dbul sel nor skyong tshogs// mi zad 'dod rgur dbang rnams kyi// dgos 'byung longs spyod gter mdzod de// deng 'dir= /rigs rgyud snag 'brang dang skyes lha// 'go ba'i dgra lha dpung gnyen du// mi 'bral zung du 'grogs pa'i g.yang*// deng 'dir= /dam ldan dkar po'i phyogs skyong ba'i// yul lha gzhi bdag gnas srung rnams// rkyen bsal mthun 'grub mi 'bral g.yang*// deng 'dir= /snang srid snod bcud dkyil 'khor lha// gdod nas dag pa lhun grub gshis// gnas lugs phyag rgya chen po'i g.yang*// deng 'dir khu ye phywa g.yang len// zhes dang*/ kye/ tshe snang mtha' yas rnam par rgyal// 'phags pa pad 'byung grub rgyal sogs// 'chi med brnyes rnams tshe dngos de// deng 'dir khu ye phywa g.yang len// bde gshegs mched bdun sprul pa lnga// nang pa lha mi drang srong phye'i// na gso 'chi slong sman nus de// deng 'dir= /'jam mgon ngag dbang dbyangs can sogs// phyogs dus rgyal ba sras bcas kyi// mkhyen rab blo gros spobs pa de// deng 'dir= /snying rje'i spyan ras 'gror gzigs mgon// sa dang lam gnas byang sems rnams// thugs bskyed gzhan don phyogs med de// deng 'dir=

/gsang bdag rdor 'dzin rta mgrin sogs// gsang sngags rig gzungs grub brnyes pas// log 'dren gzhom pa'i mthu stobs de// deng 'dir= /'dul ba mdo sde ma mo sngags// gsar rnying bstan 'dzin brgyud bcas kyi// spangs rtogs brtul zhugs grub 'bras de// deng 'dir= /rgya bod mkhan slob paṇa grub los// 'chad nyan rtsom bsgyur sgom sgrub rgyun// sa rgyar mkha' yun gdal ba'i g.yang*// deng 'dir= /mo rtsis rdzas sngags sgom sgrub sogs// zag bcas zag med mngon mkhyen lngas// dus gsum gsal ston pra g.yang de// deng 'dir= /sor 'brang sogs lnga pad+ma 'byung*// nā gārdzu na drang song sogs// sri 'dul srid spel srung skyob g.yang*// deng 'dir= /lha klu gnod sbyin gter gyi bdag /brgyad brgyad blon 'khor 'bangs bcas kyi// 'dzad med dbyig gi bang mdzod de// deng 'dir= /dzaṃ la nor rgyun rnams mang bu// gnod sbyin sde dpon 'brog gnas sogs// rkang bzhi'i phyugs spel dmu g.yang de// deng 'dir= /mkhar khyim thab mdzod 'dod 'jo'i lha// ma phyi'i grogs rgyal mthing ge sogs// bza' btung zas bcud srid g.yang de// deng 'dir= /ma dros chu bzhi gangs can ri// 'bigs byed yul drug 'dzam gling spyi'i// skam gsher yul gnas gzhi bdag g.yang*// deng 'dir= /khyad par ti se thang lha rma// ma pham g.yu mtsho khri shor sogs// bod khams gnas bdag rma g.yang de// deng 'dir= /chos rgyal rigs ldan mang bkur sogs// mi dbang gser dngul zangs lcags kyi// 'khor los sgyur rnams chab srid bstan// deng 'dir= /gshen rabs phywa lha dgu khri 'bum// thug kar sum brgya drug cu sogs// g.yung drung bon dbang phywa g.yang de// deng 'dir= /'phags bod bde 'byung o rgyan sogs// rgyal bstan spel skyong chos kyi khrims// bstan 'gror dge ba'i legs mdzod de// deng 'dir=

/stag gzig rgya bod hor khrom sogs// nor spel dgra 'dul gnyen skyong ba'i// che btsun btsan phyug rgyal srid g.yang*// deng 'dir= /mtha' klung dbus ljongs tsi na sogs// mi rgyud lo 'bras 'phen dar 'phel// rin chen ja dar gos zas g.yang*// deng 'dir khu ye phywa g.yang len// kye/ stong khams gsum na yul bde zhing*// rdzong btsan khrims brtan dus char 'bebs// lo legs chos dar phyi yi g.yang*// deng 'dir khu ye phywa g.yang len// mi chos phyugs rgyud 'phel nang gshin// pho dpa' mo mdzangs 'og rta mgyogs// go btsan mtshon rno nang gi g.yang*// deng 'dir= /mkhas grub rtsod rgyal don gnyis 'grub// nad med tshe ring brgyags skyed bde// mthar thug 'tshang rgya don gyi g.yang*// deng 'dir= /chos dbyings chos can bslu med mthus// bden pa'i tshig la dbang rnams kyis// ci btab smon lam 'grub pa'i g.yang*// deng 'dir khu ye= /tshogs rdzogs rten 'brel mnga' thang las// rdzas rtags rgyal srid nye bcas kyi// 'jig rten dge mdzad bkra shis g.yang*// deng 'dir khu ye phywa g.yang len// ces grub chen thang stong rgyal po'i gsung byin rlabs can 'di nyid dmigs pa rtse gcig pas mda' dar g.yob cing gyer/ mthar dngos grub kyi rdzas rnams nas longs spyad par bya'o// tshar grangs du byed na mchod pa rnams kha gsos la/ oṃ a mṛ ta hūm̐ phaṭa/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ rnam dag chos kun skye med ngang du yal// nas 'di bar bskyar bas 'thus shing*/ nyin snga ma rnams su 'dir mchod bstod yig brgya brtan bzhugs sogs 'og nas 'byung ba ltar dang*/ dgong mor/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ tshom me le du ka tha na swā hā/ zhes rnam par mi rtog pa'i sngags 'di bzhi brgya re bzla/ grol nyin yon bdag bsgo ba sogs dkyus ltar ro// de nas g.yang yon bdag la gtad pa ni/ sbyin bdag chas rgyan bzang po dang bcas slob dpon la zhal skyems drang*/

dgyes pa'i yon dang phyag phul nas/ kye/ sngags 'chang rgyal po gsan du gsol// phywa dang g.yang gi bdag po khyod// sngon gyi rten 'brel mthu stobs kyis// bdag la phywa g.yang dngos grub stsol// zhes zhu/ de nas mdun du stan dkar bting ba la 'khod pa la/ sngags 'chang gis mda' dar g.yang khug sogs thogs la/ kye/ de ring rgyu sbyor yon gyi bdag po 'di'i// mi yi g.yang dang phyugs kyi bcud// pha mtshan dgra bla'i bkrag g.yang bcas// bkra shis g.yang rten g.yang rdzas rnams// gti mug rmongs pa'i lag tu g.yang mi gtad// zhe sdang khros pa'i lag tu g.yang mi gtad// 'dod chags glen pa'i lag tu g.yang mi gtad// nga rgyal dregs pa'i lag tu g.yang mi gtad// phrag dog gtum pa'i lag tu g.yang mi gtad// pha spun phyi tsho'i lag tu g.yang mi gtad// bu sring mag pa'i lag tu= /'dre srin byur gsum lag= /mi la bse rag lag tu= /god 'dre the rang lag tu g.yang mi gtad// ces brjod la g.yang khug mda' dar sogs yon bdag rnams lag stong mi 'ong bar gtad nas/ kye/ g.yang gtad yon bdag 'di la gtad// g.yang sgye rin chen sna lnga'i bcud// dar sna rnga ma'i rgyan gyis brgyan// dkar gsal gangs la nyi shar 'dra// g.yang gdan gangs las dkar ba'i g.yang*// rin chen sna lnga bcug pa 'di// mi nor rta gsum 'phel ba'i g.yang*// pha ma bu gsum skyid 'dzom g.yang*// de ring yon bdag khyed la gtad// g.yang sgye kha sgrog ma shud gcig /nang bcud srub nas ma ral cig /dar thag bkrag mdangs ma nyams shig /'dre srin zhabs su ma 'jabs shig /g.yang spel 'dab brgyad 'di gtad pas// mi nor 'dab lag rgyas pa'i g.yang*// nang du gser sbrul 'khyil ba 'di// klu dpal mi la 'khor ba'i g.yang*// mar zhun nang du 'khyil ba 'di// bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun 'bebs pa'i g.yang*// de ring yon bdag khyod la gtad// g.yang spel 'dab brgyad ma grug cig

/gser sbrul mkha' lding ma 'jums shig /zhun gsum 'dre yis ma rloms shig /bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun ma skoms shig /bkra shis rma g.yang 'khor bar shog /g.yang nas rin chen snod du blugs// mi 'bru nas bas bzang ba'i g.yang*// mi 'phel nas bas 'phel ba'i g.yang*// rin chen zas nor 'khor ba'i g.yang*// de ring yon bdag khyod la gtad// g.yang nas dgra yis ma khyer zhig /rin chen 'phel g.yang thob par shog /ces gtad/ de nas g.yang sgo srung sdom la/ dang po bka' bsgo ba ni/ kye/ de ring nyi ma'i gdugs gang la// rgyu sbyor yon gyi bdag po yis// sngags 'chang rgyal po spyan drangs nas// dbu la thod bcings mgul skyems drangs// phyag tu mnyes pa'i lha yon phul// mi yi g.yang dang phyugs kyi rtsi// mi phyugs g.yang skyabs bsgrub pa'i phyir// lha mi'i longs spyod mchod par bshams// mgron rigs bzhi po dgyes par mchod// g.yang rab sgo bzhi snyan gson dang*// bsgo blag sngags 'chang bdag gis byed// khyim lha gel thung bya ba de// che btsan byed pa'i dgra bla yin// sku mdog dkar la 'od zer 'bar// phyag na tshe yi bum pa bsnams// yon bdag mi nor 'khor bcas la// tshe yi dmu thag gzung du gsol// khyim lha gzhan du ma 'khyams shig /phyug gi lha srung dam par mdzod// 'khor gsum sked la rten chos la// rten bcas gzhan du ma 'khyams shig /khra bo'i srung la rten chos la// rten bcos gzhan du ma 'khyams shig /phug lha ka bar rten chos la// rten bcas gzhan du ma 'khyams shig /gser gyi gdung mar rten chos la// rten bcas gzhan du ma 'khyams shig /nor lha rma g.yang bya ba ni// btsan phyug 'dzom pa'i dgra bla yin// sku mdog smug la 'od zer 'bar// phyag na yid bzhin nor bu bsnams// rgyu sbyor yon gyi bdag po la// rin po che yi g.yang spel rnams// bsam pa yid bzhin 'grub par shog

/g.yang ra'i nor phyugs srung bar mdzod// bsam pa bzhin du 'grub par mdzod// phyugs kyi rwa bar rten chos la// rten bcas gzhan du ma 'khyams shig /gser srab g.yu mthur rten chos la// rten bcas gzhan du ma 'khyams shig /g.yang mo lug gi sog bal la// rten bcas= /lha rta lha lug lha g.yag la// rten bcas= /bil dang sdong la rten chos la// rten bcas gzhan du ma 'khyams shig /thab lha rog po bya ba de// drag mdzangs byed pa'i dgra bla yin// sku mdog sna tshogs cir yang ston// phyag na bdud rtsi'i bum pa bsnams// yon bdag mi nor 'khor bcas la// bdud rtsi'i dngos grub stsal du gsol// thab 'dre gzhob 'dre ma gtong zhig /mi nor zas gsum srung skyob mdzad// rin chen gser skyems rten chos la// rten bcas= /thab lha rog po ma 'khyams shig /g.yang rten bkra shis 'khyil pa la// rten chos gzhan du ma 'khyams shig /g.yung drung 'khyil bar rten chos la// rten bcas= /mi zad longs spyod rten chos la// rten bcas= /sgo lha rta g.yang bya ba de// dpa' dar byed pa'i dgra bla yin// sku mdog nag la 'od zer 'bar// phyag na lcags kyi thu lum bsnams// dgra 'dre'i klad pa spyi nas 'joms// 'dre gdon thams cad phyir la bzlog /yon bdag mi nor g.yang sar skyol// zas nor thams cad srung bar mdzod// sgo lha mi nor mang bar mdzod// 'ching mo steng du rten chos la// rten bcas= /gser gyi 'dan bur rten chos la// rten bcas gzhan du ma 'khyams shig /rin po che yi lde mig la// rten chos gzhan du ma 'khyams shig /ces brjod la g.yang sgam yod na gtor ma sogs g.yang rdzas rnams mchod pa dang bcas byin chags par bsgrigs te/ kye/ de ring nyi ma'i gdugs gang la// yon gyi bdag po 'khor bcas la// mi g.yang phyugs rtsi rten pa yi// 'dod yon sna tshogs g.yang 'di brten// sngags 'chang bka' 'di bkra bar shog

/mi g.yang ma nyams g.yang sgo sdoms// phyugs rtsi ma 'phyugs g.yang sgo sdoms// lha srung 'khor bcas g.yang sgo sdoms// 'dre gdon mi tshugs g.yang sgo sdoms// mchong gi sgo mo tham gyis 'dan// gser gyi 'dan bus thig gis 'dan// shar sgo stag dkar skya bos srungs// lho sgo g.yu 'brug sngon mos srungs// nub sgo gnyan bya dmar pos srungs// byang sgo ru sbal rgya bos srungs// sgo srung mthu rtsal ma chung zhig /bkra shis g.yang rten ma 'phyugs shig /'dre srin nang du ma gtong zhig /bde legs phun sum tshogs par shog /ces dang brtan bzhugs smon lam bkra shis byas la sgo bsdams shing rtags gdab pa'am/ yang na 'og nas 'byung ba ltar byas kyang rung ngo*// gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa la/ dang po tsā ru'i bza' ba ni/ bzar rung ba'i 'brang rgyas rgyan ci mdzes can dang*/ bza' bca' btung ba'i rigs ci 'byor bshams shing bran la/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du zhal zas kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum dang*/ gang ba'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ zhal zas ro brgya ldan pa'i yid 'phrog par// legs sbyar 'di ni rgyal ba sras bcas la// dad pas phul bas 'gro ba 'di dag kun// 'byor ldan ting 'dzin zas la spyod par shog /de bzhin du/ legs sbyar 'di ni bla ma yi dam la// dang*/ chos srung nor lha la zhes bsgyur ba dang*/ oṃ di bya an+ne sa ma dhi dh+yū na pṛ ṇa ne swā hā/ zhes phud gsum phul/ lhag ma dngos grub kyi gter chen po zag med kyi bdud rtsir mos pas 'bul len gyi tshul du mchod g.yog pas/ bde bar gshegs pas gsol ba yi// lhag mas dngos grub thob pas bzhes// zhes slob dpon sogs la drang*/ des/

bde bar gshegs pas gsol ba yi// lhag mas dngos grub thob pas rol// zhes lan/ gzhan sbyin bdag sogs la/ bde gshegs lhag ma 'di dag ni// zo zhig dngos grub thob par 'gyur// zhes sbyin/ bde gshegs lhag ma 'di dag ni// zos pas dngos grub thob phyir rol// ces thams cad la zas sna tshang bar brim/ mthar dpon slob lhan cig pas/ thams cad nam mkha'i mdzod bzhin du// longs spyod zad pa med par shog /rtsod pa med cing 'tshe med par// rang dbang du ni spyod par shog /ces gdangs dang bcas lan gsum gyis smon lam gdab/ mchod bstod gong ltar bya/ yig brgya lan bdun gyis nongs pa bshags/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis bzod par gsol/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ ji srid nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i sa la ma bzhag gi bar du rgyal ba rnams mya ngan las mi 'da' bar brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ bye brag tu'ang mdun gyi rten 'di rnams la bskyed cing spyan drangs pa'i lha tshogs rnams ji srid 'byung ba bzhi'i gnod pas ma zhig gi bar du brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ brtan par bzhugs nas bdag dang sems can thams cad la chos dang mthun pa'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa stsal du gsol/ khyad par du rten 'di nyid gang du bzhugs pa'i sa phyogs su chos spyod dge bcu lhur len pa'i dge slong gi dge 'dun gyi tshogs brgya stong phrag mang po 'du ba dang*/ chos kyi sbyin bdag tu gyur pa'i rgyal po dang blon po dang btsun mo dang mi chen stobs ldan 'byor ldan thams cad dang*/ 'jig rten gyi khams kyi lha mi'i dpal 'byor longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa thams cad rten 'di'i dbang du gyur cig swā hā/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+rā ya swā hā/ zhes lan bdun gyis brtan par bzhugs su gsol/

rang gi dpral bar oṃ dkar po sogs kyis gnas gsum bsrung*/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /'phags pa dzaṃ la 'grub gyur nas// sogs kyis smon lam dang*/ che ba'i che mchog ston mchog bla na med// chos rje nyi ma rgyal ba'i byin rlabs kyis// bdud dang bgegs rigs gnod pa'i dgra zhi ste// rtag tu dpal gnas nyin mtshan bkra shis shog /chos nyid bden pa'i chos mchog bla na med// dam chos bdud rtsi bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis// nyon mongs sdug bsngal gdung ba'i dgra zhi ste// rtag tu dpal gnas nyin mtshan bkra shis shog /dge 'dun yon tan rin chen dpal 'bar ba// rgyal sras phan mdzad bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis// nyes pa'i skyon bral dge tshogs rnam par 'phel// rtag tu dpal gnas nyin mtshan bkra shis shog /tshangs dang lha dbang srung ma'i byin rlabs kyis// phan mdzad lha yi bkra shis gnas gyur te// bde legs bsam pa yid bzhin 'grub pa dang*// tshe ring nad med bde skyid ldan par shog /ces dang*/ 'bad dang rtsol bas ma gos pa// yid bzhin nor bu dpag bsam bzhin// sems can re ba skong mdzad pa// bsam pa 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog /ces sogs bkra shis rgyas par brjod pas mtha' brgyan par bya zhing*/ de ltar bsgrubs pa'i g.yang rten gtor rdzas gwa'u rnams dar gos la sogs pa'i lding gur dang bcas bang mdzod du 'bru dang bkra shis pa'i rdzas sna ci 'dzoms spungs pa'i dbus su bzhugs pa de la longs spyod gang byung gi phud sogs dus skabs la mchod pa dang*/ gtor ma phul bas kha gso/ g.yang can gyi nor sna rnyed na phyogs su tshags bya/ gzhan dngos grub gang byung mchod sbyin la ser sna med par gtong ba nor lha spyi'i dam tshig yin no// 'dir 'bad dge ba'i chu gter las// phan bde nor bu'i char 'bebs pas// snod bcud rgud pa ring bskrad de// 'gro kun rdzogs ldan bder spyod shog

/ces rje thams cad mkhyen pa de nyid kyi bka' lung gi rjes su gnang ba thob par brten nas blo gter dbang pos rgya tshan chos rje ngag dbang mthar phyin gyis mdzad pa'i dzaṃ dkar g.yang skyabs las sa bcad sogs kyi spros pa rnams dor zhing*/ mnyam med jo bo dī paṃ ka ra nas brgyud pa'i sgrub thabs sogs dkyus su bcug nas lag tu blang bde bar bris pa dge legs 'phel// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
